why_superseded_before_results: The v0.3 arbitrary-mismatch-pair optimistic bound is too loose to discriminate the mechanism: it ignores whether a mismatch set can arise from any tip-state assignment and can remain large even when the frozen binary generator cannot produce a measurable system. No v0.3 result was executed or opened.
purpose: Test whether the categorical calibration ceiling arises because stronger latent phylogenetic memory drives thresholded binary states toward monomorphism before the frozen rho=0.15 benchmark becomes admissibly measurable.
source: The complete S3 pilot calibration grids already stored for the 683 novel known-truth systems from workflow 37086693588; no real trait values and no observed memory rho.
mechanistic_identity: For nominal binary systems, binary_effects is finite only when both states occur among tips. Therefore pilot valid_fraction is exactly the fraction of simulated replicates retaining polymorphism sufficient to define the mismatch correlation.
tests: For every system, record the maximum pilot median rho over all frozen lambda values and the valid_fraction at that same lambda.
Separately record the maximum pilot median rho among grid points satisfying the already-frozen valid_fraction >= 0.90 requirement.
Within each system, summarize the rank association of log(lambda) with valid_fraction and with pilot median rho.

For categorical CALIBRATION_NO_BRACKET systems, classify mechanism as VALIDITY_COLLAPSE if the unconstrained grid reaches rho >= 0.15 but the admissible grid does not; classify as EFFECT_CEILING if even the unconstrained grid never reaches rho=0.15.
Use continuous-scalar systems only as a sanity comparison for valid_fraction behavior, not as a biological contrast.
primary_prediction: If loss of binary polymorphism is the dominant mechanism, most categorical no-bracket systems will be VALIDITY_COLLAPSE and valid_fraction will decline strongly as lambda increases. If most are EFFECT_CEILING, the ceiling lies earlier in the generator-tree-estimator coupling and cannot be explained by monomorphism alone.
interpretation_guard: This analysis concerns measurement under a frozen latent-OU-threshold generator and binary mismatch estimator. It is not evidence that categorical biological traits are intrinsically less conserved.
